'''Therbon''' was an individual who served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] shortly after the [[Declaration of a New Order|Declaration of a]] [[New Order/Legends|New Order]]. Therbon was made [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] of the [[Maldrood Oversector/Legends|Maldrood Oversector]] and commander of the [[Twelfth Army/Legends|Twelfth Army]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]].<ref name="TEGTW" />

In [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], the aged Grand Moff Therbon grew frustrated with his inability to retake [[Dac/Legends|Mon Calamari]].<ref name="SOR" /> Since the Empire had been unwilling to gather a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] large enough to assault the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], he deployed an [[assault fleet]] comprised of [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] to [[Bombardment of Ruisto|bombard]] [[Ruisto]].<ref name="RES">''[[Rebellion Era Sourcebook]]''</ref> During the attack, Grand Moff Therbon ordered a [[Base Delta Zero/Legends|sustained]] [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|orbital bombardment]] that [[Mundicide|wiped out]] all life on Ruisto.<ref name="SOR" />
